leg.text: Bolas sends Ramses Overdark to reclaim the rebellious Edemi Islands, but Overdark disobeys his orders and sends agents there, including Halfdane and a forged decree to bring Orca.
He lures Jorgan Hage into a trap and corrupts him with black magic, and Hage decapitates Elsdragon, usurping the title of general as Overdark's minion.
Bolas, impressed by his ambition, names Overdark imperial regent, but Tetsuo renounces his title as imperial champion and swears vengeance.
Kolo Meha destroys Overdark's keep at Tetsuo's order, and Tetsuo fights his way to the Imperial Shrine, kills Overdark and absorbs his powers.
